query: My cat just knocked over my favorite potted succulent this morning, I had to spend 20 minutes cleaning soil off the carpet and making sure she didn't eat any of the leaves. Also, I was super excited to try the new matcha latte from the café down the street earlier, but they accidentally gave me an oat milk one even though I asked for almond, it was still good but not exactly what I wanted. Oh, and my neighbor just dropped off a bag of homemade chocolate chip cookies they baked this weekend, they're still warm and taste amazing. Anyway, I need to exchange an item from my delivered order #W6390527: I want to swap item 8384507844 for item 7624783998, and use paypal_7644869 as the payment method for any additional costs related to the exchange.
